image.subsector: Infrastructure-adjacent road-marking and engineered glass materials
image.description: Potters Industries, LLC manufactures glass beads, microspheres and engineered materials used in road and airfield markings and specialized industrial applications. The company is headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania and operates a broad manufacturing and logistics network across North America and Europe, with additional presence in South America and Asia. A Macquarie Asset Management-led consortium acquired control in December 2025 through the Macquarie Strategic Opportunities Fund infrastructure-adjacent private-equity strategy. UniSuper publicly discloses an approximately 30% interest and Partners Capital is a named co-investor; the remaining consortium split is not publicly disclosed.

image.description: TraPac, LLC operates marine container terminals in Los Angeles and Oakland serving ocean carriers, truckers, rail providers and cargo owners moving containerized freight through the U.S. West Coast. Ocean Network Express acquired 51% on November 2, 2023 and Macquarie Infrastructure Partners VI acquired 49% on November 1, 2023; the owners exercise joint control. Mitsui O.S.K. Lines and Brookfield Asset Management are former owners. TraPac Jacksonville transferred separately to Ceres in 2022 and is excluded from this platform boundary.

image.description: Yusen Terminals LLC operates a marine container terminal at the Port of Los Angeles on Terminal Island. Its infrastructure includes berths, cargo-handling cranes, storage yards, gate systems, on-dock rail and shore-power facilities serving container lines and North American import and export supply chains. image.name: TowerPoint Infrastructure Partners
image.description: TowerPoint Infrastructure Partners is a U.S. wireless-infrastructure platform that acquires, owns, and manages towers, easements, rooftops, and related telecom real estate for wireless carriers and other network operators. The business traces its operating roots to 2007 and reported more than 900 assets across 49 states and approximately $1.5 billion invested by year-end 2025. Meritage Group and Ullico Infrastructure Fund entered through the December 2024 recapitalization, and Munich Re later acquired a 15.0% interest through MEAG-managed MR Highland. TowerPoint Capital manages the platform; its direct equity participation is not publicly disclosed and is not recorded as ownership.

image.name: Centre de recherche du CHUM (CRCHUM)
aliases: University of Montreal Hospital Research Centre
image.description: Centre de recherche du CHUM (CRCHUM) is a long-term social-infrastructure public-private partnership in Montréal that houses health-research, learning, simulation, and administrative functions for the Centre hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal. image.name: Altán Redes, S.A.P.I. de C.V.
image.description: Altán Redes operates Red Compartida, Mexico's national wholesale mobile network. The platform provides 4.5G LTE wholesale capacity to mobile network operators, MVNOs, enterprises, and public-sector users and reports coverage above 94% of Mexico's population. Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners remains the majority owner through the Marapendi and North Haven Infrastructure Partners II chain with 51.37% of Altán's capital. Comisión Federal de Electricidad acquired the remaining 48.63% through trust F/1320 in 2025. Separate governance rights held by Mexican development banks arise from restructuring debt and are not recorded as equity ownership.

image.name: Millennium Parking Garages, LLC
image.description: Millennium Parking Garages, LLC operates the long-term concession for four underground parking garages beneath Millennium, Grant and Maggie Daley Parks in downtown Chicago. Northleaf and AMP Capital acquired the concession on May 18, 2016. Northleaf continues to hold an inferred 50% interest, while InfraBridge manages the other 50% through Global Infrastructure Fund I following its February 2, 2023 succession to AMP Capital's infrastructure-equity management business. No subsequent sale or signed ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.

image.name: Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC
image.description: Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC operates the long-term tolled-road concession south of Richmond, Virginia. Northleaf joined as a direct co-investor in 2017 and remains active; its exact ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. No later equity sale or signed pending transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
